svg.title: Abu Dhabi Grand Prix stay-zone geographic locator
svg.text: Coast, stay areas and Yas Marina Circuit
Al Danah area shown; not the whole city.
Island boundary + circuit in local detail.
Named Dubai districts are examples, not all Dubai.
No routes, travel times or hotel boundaries shown.
Geographic locator, not navigation. North-up; longitude scaled by cosine of local latitude.
Green areas = mapped place boundaries. Numbered markers locate the named areas; orange line = circuit.
